images.title: A 3 by 3 sign grid
images.purpose: Show the small sign puzzle of the video: a 3 by 3 grid with the signs +, minus and times, three placed (+ top left, times middle, minus bottom right) and six empty boxes. No solution is shown.
images.composition: A square grid of 9 boxes with three signs in the three diagonal boxes.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. GRID: one square of 3 by 3 boxes, each box 150 by 150 px, the whole grid 450 by 450 px (x 503 to 953, y 183 to 633) with thin dark lines, boxes filled white. SIGNS in 96 px bold: the top left box (x 503 to 653, y 183 to 333) holds the sign + in teal #0072B2, the middle box (x 653 to 803, y 333 to 483) holds the sign × in amber #E69F00, the bottom right box (x 803 to 953, y 483 to 633) holds the sign − (the minus sign U+2212) in reddish purple #CC79A7. The other 6 boxes are empty. Under the grid, y 700, the caption each row and column has +, − and × once in 40 px. In all: 9 boxes, 3 signs, 6 empty boxes. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: each row and column has +, − and × once
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any sign in the six empty boxes
images.takeaway: Each sign must appear once in every row and every column.
images.description: A 3 by 3 grid with + in the top left box, × in the middle box and − in the bottom right box, six boxes empty.
images.context: Concept image for Sign Puzzle: One Clue at a Time. It follows the idea of the sign grid in your maths book (no sign repeated in a row or column) on a smaller 3 by 3 grid of the concept's own (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Let the student find the first box with one choice. The slip to watch: placing a sign that is already in the row.
